Messages.Author: INFJ
Messages.Body:
> Laibon magaji: Undele may call a referendum to move two minion cards from your ash heap to your hand as a +1 stealth political action (discard afterward).
Do you need to discard down afterward if your hand size before the referendum was 5 or less due to no cards left in the library?

You have a hand of 5 (because you have no more cards in your library) and vote up 2 cards to your hand. 7 cards are the allowed amount, so I don't think you need to discard down now. But the card do state "discard afterward".

I'm pretty sure it just say so as a reminder, but I like to get it confirmed. It does make quite a difference for my Ishtarri deck whether or not my interpretation is correct.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson (Rulemonger)
Messages.Body:
You only discard if you're holding more cards than your hand size allows.

The "Discard afterward" is a reminder that you always discard to your hand size, which you do in this case by discarding zero cards.

Edit: BTW, the USENET-style tags, like "[LSJ]" aren't used generally on these forums.
